purpose: Exact current source integration inputs, separate from accepted release and publication coordinates.
proof_limits: Source verification binds checked-out Git bytes, npm manifests and locks, managed KDNA declarations, fixed archives, current Swift declarations and real npm package member sets. Other tracked formats remain byte-bound rather than structurally parsed.

Each child CI record is freshly queried for the exact reviewed tree and all observed duplicate and post-merge tasks. These remote executions are distinct from the local root commands and do not replace the root Hosted workflow checks.

Non-required completed Dependabot automatic update jobs are reported separately as maintenance_checks only after authenticated Actions run metadata binds the exact check, run, repository, head, tree, check suite, dynamic workflow and both bot identities. Original failure conclusions and URLs remain unresolved maintenance findings, not code acceptance. Missing metadata, query failures, unknown identities, required checks and all other code/security checks remain fail-closed.

Registered child product legs remain subject to their committed recomputation rules. A successful workflow does not turn a registered not_run into executed Host adoption, provider, device or editorial acceptance.

Retained archives keep their own SHA256, SRI and complete member manifests. Equal package versions do not mean equal bytes or prove that a frozen consumer consumed the current source pack. Original producer Git commits are not inferred where the archive records do not supply one.

Studio source checkouts include a fixed vendor installation graph. Their inspection packs require the documented coordinate migration before registry publication; no standalone registry-install claim is made.

The source coordination gate and its integration policy tests use POSIX Git paths, executable modes and link behavior on Linux/macOS. Existing product tests retain their Windows matrix; protocol and SDK support is unchanged.
